details: Lilly never prints Lyumjev (insulin lispro-aabc, approved 15 Jun 2020) revenue. No Lilly supplement, data book or product-revenue Excel was found: each earnings 8-K carries only the release and the XBRL Financial_Report.xlsx rendering. Isolated figure: none. Annual report PDFs for 2013-2016 and 2017-2023 were downloaded from annualreports.com (boehringer-ingelheim_<year>.pdf; 2014 and 2024 also) and pdftotext-scanned for giotrif/gilotrif/afatinib, spiolto/stiolto, striverdi/olodaterol: every hit is clinical or portfolio prose (product-portfolio tables list brand, ingredient and indication only) and none carries a net-sales figure. The only product sales tables are 'Top 4 products' (2013-2022 summary pages) and 'Human Pharma: Net sales Top 5 products' (2021-2023 management reports). 2025 annual report and H1 2025/2026 releases were not readable (bot challenge). No partner or royalty holder reports these brands: the former Spiriva co-promoter reports Spiriva only, and the 2016 Pfizer 10-K exhibit cites only the Spiriva co-promotion. Half-year-only and annual-only reporting was ruled out because no brand figure is printed in any year read.
moa: long-acting muscarinic antagonist (tiotropium) plus long-acting beta2-agonist (olodaterol) fixed-dose combination
source_quote: Boehringer Ingelheim Annual Report 2023, 'Human Pharma: Net sales Top 5 products (in million EUR)' table, 2023 column | JARDIANCE® family 7,382 | OFEV® 3,510 | TRAJENTA® / JENTADUETO® 1,706 | SPIRIVA® 1,290 | PRADAXA® 845 (no other Human Pharma product is listed)

details: Kynamro (mipomersen) was marketed by Genzyme (a Sanofi company) from its 2013 US approval. Sanofi's most detailed product table (Form 20-F, product net sales by franchise) has no Kynamro line, so it is at most inside 'Other products'. Isis/Ionis (CIK 874015) Forms 10-K for 2014 and 2015 describe a profit share with Genzyme but print no Kynamro net sales figure. Sanofi 20-Fs for 2013-2016 were text-searched for 'Kynamro': only the manufacturing-site, launch-expense and amortization mentions exist. Not checked: Sanofi quarterly press-release tables, and the later Kastle Therapeutics owner named in the request (not confirmed as an owner or searched).
moa: Antisense oligonucleotide inhibitor of apolipoprotein B-100 synthesis (second-generation antisense; mipomersen)
source_quote: Sanofi Form 20-F for 2014, net sales by product, Genzyme (EUR million, 2014 then 2013): Cerezyme | Gaucher disease | 715 | 688 ; Cerdelga | 4 | - ; Myozyme/Lumizyme | 542 | 500 ; Fabrazyme | 460 | 383 ; Aldurazyme | 172 | 159 ; Other products | 244 | 244 ; Aubagio | 433 | 166 ; Lemtrada | 34 | 2 ; Total: Genzyme | 2,604 | 2,142. Kynamro appears in this 20-F only in the list of manufacturing sites and in the note on amortized acquired R&D, never in a sales line.

details: Glenmark's MD&A for Q1 FY27 and Q4 FY26, its Q4 FY25 and Q4 FY26 investor decks and its Annual Report 2025-26 mention Ryaltris only as growth percentages, market-share statements and launches; none prints a Ryaltris sales amount in any currency (text-searched every line containing 'Ryaltris' for amounts). Revenue is reported only by region (for example North America in rupees millions). The US licensee Hikma (launch press release 2022-08-30) is not shown to break the product out; Glenmark took over US commercialization in FY26. Not completed: the Hikma 2022 and 2023 annual reports and Glenmark quarterly decks for FY23-FY25 were not all searched line by line.
moa: Fixed-dose combination of an H1-receptor antagonist (olopatadine) and a corticosteroid (mometasone) delivered as a nasal spray
source_quote: Glenmark Management Discussion & Analysis Q4 FY26, page 2: RYALTRIS sustained strong global momentum, recording >50% growth in secondary sales across commercial markets in FY26, alongside marketing authorization (MA) approval and launch in China and Thailand; Glenmark also initiated end-to-end commercialization of RYALTRIS in the USA.

details: Mylanta is sold in the US by Infirst Healthcare Inc. under a trademark licence from McNeil Consumer Pharmaceuticals (Johnson & Johnson, later Kenvue), and Infirst was acquired in October 2023 by Carlin Consumer Health, a private company; no filing by either prints Mylanta sales. Kenvue's Forms 10-K for 2023 and 2025 (kvue-20231231.htm, kvue-20251228.htm) were text-searched and contain no mention of Mylanta; Johnson & Johnson did not break Mylanta out and was not searched line by line. Not searched: Kenvue ex-US reporting beyond those two 10-Ks.
moa: Antacid (aluminum hydroxide and magnesium hydroxide neutralize gastric acid) combined with simethicone as an anti-gas anti-foaming agent
source_quote: Infirst is the marketer of two iconic digestive health brands, Mylanta and Mylicon, pursuant to a trademark licensing agreement with McNeil Consumer Pharmaceuticals Co. ... The financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

details: Rydapt (midostaurin) was approved by FDA in April 2017 and launched by Novartis in 2017 (Novartis Q4 2017 and FY2017 20-F text names Rydapt as a 2017 launch without a sales figure). In every Novartis results document searched (60 interim reports 2012Q2 to 2026Q2, plus the 2010 to 2012Q1 reports) the word Rydapt appears only in pipeline, approval and narrative text, never in a net sales table row; its sales sit inside the Oncology 'Other' line, and in the 2026 reports the oncology table lists Kisqali, Pluvicto, Jakavi, Tafinlar + Mekinist, Scemblix, Lutathera and 'Other 4' with no Rydapt row. The Bigdata.com search of Novartis filings returned no Rydapt sales figure. No licensee or royalty holder discloses Rydapt sales (Novartis owns the product).
moa: FLT3 and multi-kinase (KIT, PDGFR, VEGFR2) inhibitor
source_quote: Novartis Q4 2017 Oncology business unit net sales by product table, USD millions, columns Q4 2017, Q4 2016, % change USD, % change cc: Kisqali | 35 | 0 | nm | nm then Other | 224 | 239 | -6 | -8 then Total Oncology business unit | 3 243 | 3 207 | 1 | -1 (no Rydapt row)

details: OBIZUR is folded into the 'Others' row of Rare Hematology in every Takeda product sales table; the FY2026 Q1 table (qr2026_q1_qfr_en.pdf) lists ADVATE, ADYNOVATE/ADYNOVI, VONVENDI and others by name but no OBIZUR row. Searched: Takeda data books/QFRs FY2019-FY2026 Q1, 20-F and annual securities reports (no sales figure), Baxalta 10-K FY2015 and 10-Qs (only the 'Inhibitor Therapies' category, which combines FEIBA and OBIZUR), Shire 10-K/10-Q/8-K 2016-2018 (no OBIZUR line), Bigdata.com filings search for OBIZUR net sales (no results). No partner or royalty holder prints OBIZUR sales in the documents checked.
moa: recombinant porcine sequence factor VIII replacement
source_quote: *7 Others in Rare Hematology include VONVENDI, OBIZUR, RIXUBIS, AGRYLIN/XAGRID, OCTOFACTOR, COAGIL-VII, INNONAFACTOR, and Other Hemophilia.

details: Veyvondi is the EU brand name of the molecule sold as Vonvendi in the U.S. (Takeda's pipeline tables print 'VONVENDI ... VEYVONDI (EU)' as one product). Takeda has no VEYVONDI row in any product sales table: ex-U.S. sales appear inside the single worldwide VONVENDI row, whose Japan and Europe and Canada columns (0.2 and 1.1 billion JPY for FY2023 Q1) carry them. That row is delivered as takeda_vonvendi (worldwide, both brand names); an ex-U.S. Veyvondi figure is not printed as a number and is not derived here. Searched: Takeda data books/QFRs FY2019-FY2026 Q1 (zero VEYVONDI sales rows), 20-F and securities reports (none), Shire/Baxalta filings (none).
moa: recombinant von Willebrand factor replacement

details: AstraZeneca's 'Duaklir' row is Duaklir Genuair, sold almost entirely in Europe; the US brand Duaklir Pressair (FDA approval 29 Mar 2019, US launch 21 Oct 2019) was commercialised by Circassia, with AstraZeneca manufacturing and supplying. Rungs tried, in order. (a) AstraZeneca quarterly results releases 2015-2026: the Duaklir row exists to Q4 2019 only; its US column is 3 in Q4 2019 and for the full year 2019 (supply to the commercialising partner, not end-market sales), no Duaklir row in the Q1 2020 and later releases. (b) AstraZeneca fuller tables: the same releases' regional Product Sales tables are its most detailed product list; no AstraZeneca annual or data-book table prints a US end-market figure. (c) Partner: Circassia's 9 Jan 2020 trading update says only 'a modest contribution from Duaklir'; its 16 Jun 2020 preliminary results headline gives Tudorza 'net in-market sales totalled GBP27.0 million' but for Duaklir only 'NDA approved H1 2019 with launch Q4 2019'; its 24 Mar 2021 results report Tudorza and Duaklir together as one discontinued COPD segment ('the Tudorza and Duaklir Pressair products'). The full FY2019 preliminary-results PDF and FY2019 annual report could not be retrieved (HTTP 202 / bot wall from investors.niox.com and circassia.com), so a Duaklir figure inside them is not ruled out, and a document the verifier cannot fetch could not be cited anyway. Covis Pharma (acquirer of the rights from AstraZeneca, completed Jan 2022) is private and publishes no sales. (d) Prior owner: Almirall licensed the product to AstraZeneca; no Almirall document was read. (e) Annual series: no issuer document read prints an annual US figure for the brand. Not searched: Almirall annual reports.
moa: Long-acting muscarinic antagonist plus long-acting beta2-agonist fixed-dose combination
source_quote: In 2019, the overwhelming majority of sales were in Europe, where sales declined by 22% (17% at CER) to $71m, mainly a result of an adverse performance in Germany. As part of the collaboration agreement announced in March 2017, Circassia Pharmaceuticals plc (Circassia) became responsible for the commercialisation of Duaklir in the US, with AstraZeneca continuing to manufacture and supply the medicine.

details: Johnson & Johnson's most detailed product table (the quarterly sales schedule, 50 PDFs 2014Q3-2026Q2 plus the 2026Q3 8-K exhibit 99.2) never prints an INVEGA HAFYERA line; its paliperidone line is labelled 'INVEGA SUSTENNA / XEPLION / INVEGA TRINZA / TREVICTA' (2Q26 schedule, WW 1,015 992 for the quarter) and Hafyera's sales are either inside it or inside OTHER NEUROSCIENCE (the schedule does not say which; not inferred). The 10-Q/10-K segment tables (2021-2023 reviewed) and the 8-K/A filings carry no Hafyera figure; the FY2022 10-K says only 'the launch of INVEGA HAFYERA' with no number. The royalty holder Alkermes reports royalty revenue on the pooled 'long-acting INVEGA products' (10-K FY2023: 486.1 million for 2023), never on Hafyera alone. No public document searched prints Hafyera's own sales, quarterly or annual.
moa: D2/5-HT2A antagonist long-acting injectable (paliperidone palmitate, 6-month dosing)
source_quote: Alkermes 10-K FY2023: INVEGA SUSTENNA/XEPLION (paliperidone palmitate), INVEGA TRINZA/TREVICTA (paliperidone palmitate) and INVEGA HAFYERA/BYANNLI (paliperidone palmitate) (collectively, the "long-acting INVEGA products") are long-acting atypical antipsychotics owned and commercialized worldwide by Janssen.

details: Johnson & Johnson prints PREZCOBIX only inside the single combined line 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA / SYMTUZA' (US, Intl, WW rows): measured in every schedule PDF from 2015Q1 (where it was 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX') to 2026Q2, in the 10-Q/10-K segment tables 2017-2023 and in the 2026Q3 8-K exhibit 99.2. No schedule or filing read prints a PREZCOBIX-only row. No other issuer prints Prezcobix: Gilead's 10-K text mentions no Prezcobix revenue line.
moa: HIV-1 protease inhibitor (darunavir) plus pharmacokinetic booster (cobicistat), fixed-dose tablet
source_quote: J&J 2Q26 sales schedule, Infectious Diseases: PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA / SYMTUZA WW 372 396 (6.3)% (6.8)% 0.5% 815 799 1.9% 0.4% 1.5%

details: Johnson & Johnson prints SYMTUZA only inside the single combined line 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX / REZOLSTA / SYMTUZA' (US, Intl, WW rows): measured in every schedule PDF from 2015Q1 (where it was 'PREZISTA / PREZCOBIX') to 2026Q2, in the 10-Q/10-K segment tables 2017-2023 and in the 2026Q3 8-K exhibit 99.2. No schedule or filing read prints a SYMTUZA-only row. Gilead Sciences, which licenses cobicistat, emtricitabine and tenofovir alafenamide to Janssen for Symtuza, reports 'Symtuza - Revenue share' in its 10-K revenue disaggregation (FY2025 10-K row: 363 | 120 | 12 | 495 by region, 2025 total; a footnote calls it 'our revenue from cobicistat, emtricitabine and tenofovir alafenamide in Symtuza ... commercialized by Janssen'). That is Gilead's share of revenue under a revenue-sharing formula, not Symtuza's net sales, and Janssen sets the price; it was not converted into a net sales figure.
moa: HIV-1 protease inhibitor (darunavir) plus pharmacokinetic booster (cobicistat) plus two NRTIs (emtricitabine, tenofovir alafenamide) fixed-dose single tablet
